notes.title: Locked keys
notes.content:
Dear friends! 

Because of the conflict with the store "Otaku" we have blocked all the keys and return the old keys can not. All this week we have been thinking about the solution to the situation. Those who had their keys revoked as: Typical Nightmare, Outside and Not my day. 
Please see the application form at email: EvilGamesStudios@yandex.ru. 

The application form should consist of the following: 
Message subject: Locked keys 
In a message to paint the points: 
1. What games were blocked and their number 
(for example, Typical Nightmare-1 key) 
2. Proof that your key is locked 
(a photo or a message from steam locked games) 
3. Attach a receipt for the purchase of the game 
(if you do not have a check, the application will be considered longer) 
To speed up the application process, please provide more information about the purchase.

Response time may take some time. Please do not flood in the comments. The application form is mandatory.
The application is accepted only by mail!

With respect ElectroStalin Entertainment!

notes.title: A quick update of the game!
notes.content:
Dear, comrades!

We want to inform you that at the moment we are preparing a big update that will bring great changes to the game itself, which will fix all the problems you have written, including optimization. 
We understand that people who bought our game expected this from the start of the game (as it is not early access), unfortunately we did not have time to prepare everything in time for the timing. In the first quarter of 2019, we are preparing a major update that will give the game a second wind, which will allow you to appreciate it. 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32552549/a3a709fa1f0021690327f23d34d790e902fd35a1.jpg
We can't share more information yet, so wait for the news! 

Sincerely, ElectroStalin Entertainment!

notes.title: An Update to Change Everything
Update 1.1
notes.content:
Dear players!

We've fixed some more bugs in the game:

- Capacity improved (5-15%)
- Three final scenes changed (actions, animations)
- A cat in the kitchen added
- ES logo added
- Bugs with collisions removed
- Tips in every scene added
- Heroes' shaking in several scenes removed  

Thanks for your feedback and support. We do our best to make Typical Nightmare better.

notes.title: Update 1.0
notes.content:
Dear players!

We fixed several bugs that spoiled your experience with Typical Nightmare:

- Subtitles fixed (they doubled and changes size)
- Jam in textures fixed
- Tips for players added
- Saving bug removed
- Sounds fixed
- Optimization partly completed
- Game weight 60% reduced
- Loading time reduced
- Several visual bugs removed
- Lift bugs fixed

Currently, we're working hard to optimize the rest of the game. We appreciate your words of support in comments and thank you for your feedback and warm response. We do our best to fix the game and improve your experience with Typical Nightmare. 

We apologize for any inconveniences.
